(Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 75 x 104 pt; not a shipped preview.)
avoid: a finished logo: it is a bare mark with no name or lettering; add type and check that the style suits the brand
a medical illustration: the brain is a simple colourful shape
print-size use at natural size: it is only about 75 x 104 pt; scale it up first
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Logo Elements; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Thinking Man")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Logo Elements.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Black profile head with rainbow brain and red rays, as described.

cards.name: Watercolor Leaf
cards.summary: Symbol 'Watercolor Leaf' from Illustrator's Logo Elements symbol library: a small sprig of three pale yellow-green leaves (two broad leaves at the lower left, one long narrow leaf reaching to the upper right) outlined in rough white dry-brush strokes, over a soft, blurred rectangular wash of pale green watercolour. On a white page the white outlines vanish and the wash reads only as a faint smudge. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on a mid-grey checker, where white paint shows white and holes show the checker, applied by script; natural size about 143 x 148 pt; not a shipped preview.)
avoid: a white or very pale page: the white brush outlines disappear and the wash is faint; place it on a dark or mid-tone ground
crisp edges: the wash is blurred and the outline rough by design
print-size use at natural size: it is only about 143 x 148 pt; scale it up first
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Logo Elements; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Watercolor Leaf")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Logo Elements.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: On the mid-grey checker the three-leaf sprig, its rough white dry-brush outlines and the soft pale-green wash are all visible, matching the card; the stale white-backing sentence was updated.

previous.note: The renderer put this pale watercolour on white because its average lightness fell just under the grey-backing threshold, so the rough white brush outline vanishes and the leaves read only as a faint smudge; on a dark ground the raw export shows a three-leaf sprig on a soft rectangular green wash.

review.changes: summary, look, avoid and confidence: shape now described from the raw export on a dark ground (a three-leaf sprig with rough white brush outlines on a soft rectangular green wash), no longer 'inferred'

cards.name: World
